title: Which AI Fashion Tool Is Best for You?
summary: Choose an AI fashion tool for your team, from concept visuals and editable flats to tech packs, collection planning, and fit review.
body_markdown:
## Try the tools on a real style


Pick a familiar style and a change you would make anyway: move a pocket, adjust a seam, or update a measurement. Give the same brief to the tools you are considering for that job.


Look at what comes back with the person who will use it. Can they make the change without starting over? Are the front and back views, trims, stitching, and callouts right? For a tech pack, have a technical designer check the measurements, materials, construction, and grading before it goes to a factory.


Open the exported file in the software you use and note the corrections and manual work still needed. If your team makes garments with very different construction, a second style can reveal different issues. For a wider look at document management and production, see the[tech pack software comparison](https://aitechpacks.com/blog/best-tech-pack-software-for-fashion-designers) .


## Frequently asked questions


### What are AI fashion tools used for?


They help teams explore concepts, present designs, create drawings, and draft technical documents, depending on the product.


### Can AI fashion design software create a tech pack?


Some products advertise tech packs or editable technical pages. Their contents and editing tools differ. A technical designer should verify measurements, materials, construction, and grading before a document goes to a factory. See the[AI tech pack software guide](https://aitechpacks.com/blog/best-ai-tech-pack-software) for a more focused comparison.


### Is an AI-generated flat sketch editable?


It depends on the file. A PNG is a raster image; an SVG can contain editable paths, though those paths may still need cleanup. Try changing a garment detail in your team’s editor. Our[hoodie SVG example](https://aitechpacks.com/blog/flat-sketch-png-to-svg-research) shows specific edits on one drawing.


### Can a generated image confirm garment fit?


A generated image can show the intended look, but it cannot confirm fit, hidden construction, or how a fabric behaves. Review the specifications and assess a physical sample. The[design-to-sample case](https://aitechpacks.com/blog/black-asymmetrical-dress-design-to-sample) illustrates a workflow that continues to a physical sample.


## Start with your next task


For a flat sketch, explore the[flat sketch generator](https://aitechpacks.com/flatsketchgenerator) . For technical documentation, see[tech pack generation](https://aitechpacks.com/features/techpack-generation) .
